method.seasons: dry seasons Oct-Mar, 2015-16 to 2025-26 (D11's dry-season months)
method.radar: Sentinel-1 VV water over each whole season (per-scene Otsu thresholds, water in >= half of the looks: tide-averaged)
method.optical: Sentinel-2 SR median MNDWI > 0 over each season's clear looks (none before Sentinel-2 SR covers the area)
method.position: as Phase 11 (landward edge of the sea-connected water); none where the line lies outside the transect
method.rate: linear regression of the radar positions over the seasons (m/yr, seaward +) with a 95 % CI, >= 5 seasons; advancing / retreating only when the CI excludes 0
method.change: radar trend confirmed by the optical shoreline moving the same way by >= 20 m between its first and last season with an optical position, else unconfirmed
